title: The Photon Lab
objectives: Tell luminous objects from non-luminous ones
Explain how we see non-luminous objects
Know that light travels in straight lines
Sort materials as transparent, translucent or opaque

stages.title: The World Has Gone Dark
stages.narration: To beat Lord Umbra, first understand light itself. Let's begin, Light Seeker!

steps.text: Lord Umbra shatters the Rainbow Crystal…
Professor Prism lights a single candle.
Ray Bot says: 'Master light to restore the crystal!'

stages.title: Find the Luminous Objects
stages.prompt: Tap every object that makes its OWN light (luminous).

feedback.correct: Yes! This object makes its own light.
feedback.incorrect: This is non-luminous — it only reflects light from elsewhere.

stages.title: Transparent, Translucent or Opaque?
stages.prompt: Sort each material by how much light it lets through.
stages.note: Transparent materials let almost all light through; opaque ones block it and cast a shadow.

stages.title: Trace the Path of Light
stages.prompt: Tap each step to trace how you see a non-luminous apple. Visit them all!

locations.label: The Sun
locations.info: Light starts at a luminous source and travels outward in straight lines.

locations.label: The Apple
locations.info: Light hits the apple and some of it reflects off the surface.

locations.label: Your Eye
locations.info: The reflected light enters your eye — and now you 'see' the apple!

locations.label: The Shadow
locations.info: Light blocked by the opaque apple leaves a dark shadow behind it.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Escape the Shadow Fog
stages.prompt: Answer at least 80% correctly to drive back the Shadow Fog and win the first crystal shard!

questions.explain: A star makes its own light. The Moon only reflects sunlight.

questions.q: We see a non-luminous book because light…
options: reflects off it into our eyes
questions.explain: Reflected light from the book reaches our eyes so we can see it.
Light always travels in straight lines, which is why shadows form.

questions.q: A shadow forms because an opaque object…
questions.explain: An opaque object blocks the straight path of light, leaving a shadow.

questions.q: Frosted glass that blurs light is…
questions.explain: Translucent materials let only some light through, so the view is blurry.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 1 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Light Seeker badge
The Shadow Fog retreats a little… Umbra is watching.
